slices.what: Preconditions in `hal`: the net lock (shared and exclusive, with witnesses), SMR for lock-free reads, pools with their own page allocator, typed in-place header views, a list with an O(1) tail; the network benchmarks
The mbuf, the packet buffer under everything (`uipc_mbuf`, `uipc_mbuf2`, `sys/mbuf.rs`)
Sockets and domains: the socket layer, local (AF_UNIX) sockets, descriptor passing; the socket system calls handled natively
The interface core: `ifnet`, the interface queues, `netisr`, link-level addresses and media
Routing: the routing table, ART, the routing socket
Link layers and bpf: Ethernet, loopback, the packet filter devices
IPv4, ARP and the protocol control block shared by both families
The nfs client and its RPC
The nfs server, the export list and a typed radix tree; nfssvc(2) handled natively
Close: `just check`, `just ci`, `just ci-full`, the comparison with a real OpenBSD (one new network scenario) green; the tag `n6-network`
